summary: Andrea Kimi Antonelli arrives in Las Vegas with a commanding 111-point lead over Max Verstappen, needing only to manage the gap over the final two races to secure Mercedes' first drivers' championship of the season. Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc sit just 13 points apart in the battle for third place, setting up a fierce internal fight that could shake the constructors' standings with two races remaining. A strong performance from Antonelli this weekend would move him within striking distance of clinching the title before the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix finale.
